verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a team project-management tool, so access-restricted private teams are a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents private teams or sub-teams limited to specific members. The only related item is creating separate Workspaces to protect sensitive information. That is an adjacent workspace-level control, not a private sub-team within a workspace, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
